mostWorthwhile.text: Following insulin to muscle was most worthwhile: it showed that insulin is a message, while glucose is the material stored for later work.

leastWorthwhile.text: Releasing glucagon felt less engaging because it was the only gameplay option and the intro had already explained its purpose.

surprise.text: The picture showed insulin staying outside the muscle cells while glucose entered and formed stored chains. That clarified the difference between a message and building material.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the pictures and goals gave each pairing a purpose, though the last two choices were the only gameplay options.

continue.text: I might continue for another chapter: connecting the after-meal and between-meal scenes was useful, though the final choices were predictable.
